mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% triggers market anticipation of aggressive fiscal stimulus and further monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in policy responses to labor market deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 500) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS < 300000) signal a severe economic contraction that triggers expectations of aggressive policy stimulus, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST < 500 and RSAFS < 300000.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%), market expectations of aggressive policy intervention drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches a policy-induced bottom.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.3% signals rising inflation expectations that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL (mo-mo) exceeds 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS < 0) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger expectations of aggressive policy stimulus, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS (mo-mo) < 0 and UNRATE > 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts level below 500 thousand units signals a severe housing market contraction that triggers market anticipation of government intervention, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST falls below 500.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production index (INDPRO < 100) signals contraction in manufacturing and industrial output that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in policy responses to the slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.
